question: In the Frozen Sick adventure, what disease can characters catch in Croaker Cave, and what are its effects?
expected_answer: Frigid woe. DC 11 Constitution save on contact with blue spores. Symptoms appear after 1d4 days: fatigue, chills, blue veins. Speed reduced by 5 feet. Every 10 days, a new DC 11 Con save or take 1d6 Cold damage and speed reduced by another 5 feet. At speed 0, the creature dies.

bm25_free_haiku.answer: Frigid woe. DC 11 Constitution save on contact with blue spores. Incubation 1d4 days. Symptoms: fatigue, chills, blue veins. Speed reduced by 5 feet. Every 10 days, DC 11 Con save or speed reduced by another 5 feet. At speed 0, creature dies and turns into ice statue. Cure: milky antidote liquid found in Eiselcross ruins. Source: Frozen Sick PDF p.1-2.
sources_cited: Frozen Sick - Wildemount Adventure - Dungeons & Dragons - Sources - D&D Beyond.pdf p.1-2

quality.notes: Correctly identified frigid woe with most effects. Two issues: (1) incorrectly stated 'characters cannot actually catch a disease specifically in Croaker Cave itself' when the blue spores ARE in Croaker Cave, (2) missing the 1d6 Cold damage on failed 10-day save. Added useful info about antidote and ice statue transformation.
